title: GMGSI global geostationary mosaic, hourly (Icechunk)
description:
NOAA Global Mosaic of Geostationary Satellite Imagery (GMGSI), a composite of GOES, Meteosat and Himawari imagery, published as an Icechunk 2.x repository at `gmgsi_v3.icechunk` on source.coop. Confirmed reachable (200 on the `repo` object, which is binary -- an Icechunk config/snapshot object, not a plain Zarr file) with CORS enabled (`access-control-allow-origin: *`). Note: an earlier probe path for this fixture (`bkr/gmgi/gmgsi.zarr/zarr.json`, without the `_v3.icechunk` suffix and as plain Zarr) 404s -- that path does not exist; the real store is the Icechunk repo at the URL below, which does. Per-array shapes/dtypes were not independently inspected; bbox is estimated for a global geostationary composite.

License unknown; declared "proprietary" with a via link.

Expected browser outcome: draws if the Icechunk client can open this 2.x layout; otherwise refused with a notice.
